Hi Alex and Priya,

Thanks again for the productive discovery call yesterday - great context on FinProspect's ingestion pipeline and latency targets. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive to walk through Redwood Inference's architecture, deployment options (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private), and the proposed integration approach for your environment.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 2026-06-23, 10:00-11:00
- Wed 2026-06-24, 14:00-15:00
- Thu 2026-06-25, 09:00-10:00

Jonas (SE) and Marissa (Solutions) are cc'd to cover performance tuning and security/compliance items. If any of these work, reply with your preferred slot and any additional attendees (network/security). I'll follow up with a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Agenda (placeholder):
- 10m: Goals & constraints
- 25m: Architecture walkthrough (serving runtime, routing, caching)
- 15m: Security/compliance & private deployment options
- 10m: Next steps / mutual action plan

Attachments: deep_dive_agenda.pdf (draft)

Thanks,
